core_result: Resolves two interlocked open-problem families from the July-September 2026 quantum Latin square literature, backed by zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 proofs (22 Palomar targets, 4 NonVacuity witnesses, 6 AdversarialTests refutations = 32 audited declarations strictly within [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound], verified across all 6 independent proof kernels on Ubuntu CI run 46014056799 + live tamper-injecting negative comparator gate, SLSA #73142116) and 10 additional polyglot engines: (I) Complete closure of the QLS(v) cardinality spectrum for all orders v >= 8 (87/87 open cases from Zhang-Lv-Cao arXiv:2607.19969 closed exactly: 1/1 at v=23 via deterministic cyclic-Venn Bjorck C_23 giving QLS(23,528) and exact p^2-1 for p in {11,19,23,31,43,47} backed by the elementary non-cyclotomic modular invariant c_k == 1 (mod m+1); 13/13 at v=9 and 73/73 at v=11 via the Dual-Punctured Odd-Order Decomposition on C^(m-1) (+) C^m, new Lean-verified Golden-Ratio POA(5,20) over (1/4)Z[sqrt(5)] and Sparse QLS(5,25) over (1/(2*sqrt(6)))Z[sqrt(6),sqrt(10)], SymPy-verified Das-Kumar POA(6,28) arXiv:2608.12607, and exact rational rotation W_R=(5/13,12/13) closing c=108; plus 14/19 exact at v=7 including Bjorck C_7 QLS(7,41) and Petrescu BH(7,6) QLS(7,45)); (II) Resolution of MCISQLS(n) across all three open congruence classes n == 0, 1, 3 (mod 4) from Zhang-Cao arXiv:2609.24653: exact impossibility of ISQLS(4) over any positive-definite field, Group-Translation Covariant reduction, unrestricted Quantum Direct Product (all n, m >= 1, removing odd-n parity restriction), two infinite 1-parameter rational curves MCISQLS(7)(t) and MCISQLS(11)(t), and seven exact closed-form witnesses spanning n in {7, 8, 9, 11, 16, 17, 19}. Differentially verified across 11 engines (Lean 4.35.0, dual Win64/ELF64 x86-64 NASM 128-bit dot kernel, ISO C11 -Werror + ASan/UBSan + 100k fuzz + 72/72 mutants + libFuzzer entry, C++20 -Werror, safe Rust #![forbid(unsafe_code)] 3-OS, Zig, Eshkol 1681-pt tangent check, Python stdlib Fraction oracle, plus explicitly labelled classical CPU simulations via Moonlab 3-qubit WASM 64-op UEB, QGTL Fubini-Study metric g_tt err 1.29e-8, and C11/JS-BigInt QRNG mixers), 13/13 live arXiv+Crossref title/author-verified citations (0 retractions), 0-warning AMS-LaTeX PDF + clean-room arXiv tarball, WCAG 2.2 AA strict-CSP interactive site, DigiCert RFC 3161 (.tsr) + 3-calendar Bitcoin (.ots), SWH swh:1:snp:f4b48ebf6074cf7850ee69c611910fd61a1663aa, 3x1,000 hardening (1,000/1,000 PASS), and 71/71 (100.0%, Core 30/30) Build Standard v1.2.0 compliance.
